name: NovaForge Local AI 2.0 evaluation corpus
description: Deterministic prompts for coding quality, grounded repository answers, constrained JSON decisions, instruction following, continuity, and generation health.

scoring.usefulTokenDefinition: A tokenizer-reported generated token that is not whitespace-only garbage, a repeated n-gram beyond the configured limit, or an unfinished cancellation tail.

receiptContract.nullMeasurementRule: Use null with an availability reason when a value was not measured; never infer physical or Core AI success from a generic build or simulator result.

cases.purpose: Keep a generated async API explicit about Sendable values at an actor boundary.

cases.purpose: Repair an isolation error without weakening the actor annotation.

cases.purpose: Repair a detached-task capture without inventing an unsafe escape hatch.
